confidence_notes: Numbeo's Agra page (updated May 2026; 310 entries from 32 contributors) gives useful meal, cappuccino and draft-beer averages. Alcohol data are thin: Expatistan warns that its Agra prices reflect fewer than 10 entries from fewer than 5 contributors, so cocktail and wine are estimated from local draft beer; accommodation remains a holistic estimate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Agra's own reported averages; accommodation reflects general North Indian heritage-tourism patterns and Agra's visitor demand, without consulting live listings.
